scope: Knell effect defaults and native constructor review; not complete combat integration
findings: The native GameplayEffect constructor explicitly zeros the reflected stack-duration-refresh and period-reset policy fields. Their enum registrations identify RefreshOnSuccessfulApplication and ResetOnSuccessfulApplication.
Knell Shred serializes Armor and MagicResist modifiers with operation 4 (MultiplyCompound); Steal uses operation 0 (AddBase). Both use SetByCaller magnitudes.

The native modifier enum has seven distinct numeric values and three legacy aliases. Alias-aware extraction preserves all labels and explicit numbers instead of mistaking repeated numeric values for corrupt data.
limits: Expiry policy has no explicit constructor store in the traced function. Unreal documents zero initialization, but post-initialization and fork-specific behavior remain to verify.
Native modifier aggregation and steal magnitude calculations still require tracing.
No complete runtime timing or server-parity claim is established.
Instruction bodies, field maps and default payloads remain private.
